presence_rationale: Dedicated 'Data protection and privacy' section with explicit governance, regulatory tracking (EU SCCs, UK IDTA, Thailand PDPA), and operational program description.
specificity_rationale: Names Chief Risk Officer for Data and Technology (Data Protection Officer), 24/7 security operations centre, data event management process (since 2019), Privacy Week, mandatory annual training, ACSC partnership, and specific regulatory responses by jurisdiction. Multiple controls and processes named.
quantification_rationale: Reports the SASB FN-CB-230a.1 metric: 'zero data breaches reported to OAIC under the Notifiable Data Breach Scheme (three in 2021)'. Also reports 178% increase in fraudulent ANZ-impersonating sites taken down and 5,556 scams investigated. Number of breaches and YoY tracking present, but no percentage personal-data breakdown and no number of customers affected.
